# hey.nous

> hey.nous is an independent publication about AI and technology, publishing in English (default) and Indonesian.
> It covers AI news, explainers, and tool guides, plus a portfolio of free web tools (drawing board, developer toolkit, pomodoro timer).

## English (default locale)
- [Home](https://nous.my.id/en/): latest stories
- [News](https://nous.my.id/en/news/): AI news archive
- [Explainers](https://nous.my.id/en/explainers/): AI explainers archive
- [Tools](https://nous.my.id/en/tools/): AI tool guides archive
- [Works](https://nous.my.id/en/works/): portfolio of free web tools
- [About](https://nous.my.id/en/about/): about hey.nous
- [Why does AI sometimes make up answers?](https://nous.my.id/en/articles/why-ai-makes-up-answers/): Language models predict the next word, they do not check facts. Here is how the mechanism works, and when you should be careful.
- [Mistral Large 4, the trillion-parameter bet from Europe](https://nous.my.id/en/articles/mistral-large-4-le-chonk/): Announced on October 6, 2026, this 1-trillion-parameter model is promised with open weights by month's end. What is certain and what is still a promise, separated.
- [When are AI tools actually useful? (and when not)](https://nous.my.id/en/articles/when-are-ai-tools-useful/): AI tools shine at specific, well-defined tasks. For vague high-stakes decisions, they are brainstorming partners, not judges.
- [Why DNS only has 13 root servers](https://nous.my.id/en/articles/why-dns-has-13-root-servers/): The global DNS system is constrained to 13 logical root servers, and the reason comes down to a packet size limit set in the 1980s.

## Indonesia
- [Beranda](https://nous.my.id/id/): cerita terbaru
- [Model OpenAI kini hadir di Google Cloud](https://nous.my.id/id/artikel/model-openai-di-google-cloud/): GPT-6 Astra, GPT-6.1 Sol, dan GPT-6 Luna mulai digulirkan dalam private preview di model garden Google Cloud, dengan penagihan lewat Google Cloud Marketplace. Apa yang diumumkan, apa yang masih menyusul, dan kenapa ini penting.
- [ChatGPT vs Claude vs Gemini vs DeepSeek: mana yang worth it dibayar?](https://nous.my.id/id/artikel/perbandingan-harga-ai-chatbot-2026/): Empat asisten AI, empat filosofi harga. ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, dan DeepSeek dibandingkan dari sisi harga, paket gratis, dan keunggulan masing-masing. Harga dicek Oktober 2026.
- [Kenapa AI kadang mengarang jawaban?](https://nous.my.id/id/artikel/kenapa-ai-mengarang-jawaban/): Model bahasa memprediksi kata berikutnya, bukan memeriksa fakta. Ini penjelasan mekanismenya, dan kapan kamu harus waspada.
- [Mistral Large 4: taruhan 1 triliun parameter dari Eropa](https://nous.my.id/id/artikel/mistral-large-4-le-chonk/): Diumumkan 6 Oktober 2026, model 1 triliun parameter ini dijanjikan berbobot terbuka akhir bulan. Yang sudah pasti dan yang masih janji, dipisahkan.
- [Kapan tool AI benar-benar berguna? (dan kapan tidak)](https://nous.my.id/id/artikel/kapan-tool-ai-berguna/): Tool AI hebat untuk tugas yang spesifik dan terdefinisi jelas. Untuk keputusan kabur berisiko tinggi, ia teman brainstorming, bukan pemberi vonis.
